verdict.rationale: Perplexity ships an official MCP server that agents can consume directly as a tool. It comes as a hosted remote endpoint or a local stdio server, supports per-tool enable/disable, and documents use through the Anthropic Messages MCP connector. A CLI returning JSON 'ready for agent tool calls' and a published OpenAPI spec round this out. Missing for 10: explicit function-calling tool schemas documented for direct use, named agent-framework integrations (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex), independent or hands-on corroboration.
